faq.description: Answers to common questions about the 30DDTX SDV6 engine in the Land Rover Discovery 4. If yours is not covered, our team can help.

faqs.q: Can an earlier 306DT engine replace a 30DDTX in my Discovery 4?
faqs.a: Not always directly. Earlier and later 3.0 V6 diesel engines can differ in emissions equipment, calibration and ancillaries, so we check your VIN and engine code before recommending a compatible replacement.

faqs.q: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt SDV6 engines compare?
faqs.a: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

faqs.q: Do you sell Discovery 4 SDV6 engines supply only?
faqs.a: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages and private customers with their own mechanic can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

faqs.q: What affects the cost of a Discovery 4 30DDTX engine replacement?
faqs.a: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any parts needed such as turbos or a DPF, and the labour involved, including body lifting. Send your registration or VIN for a quote.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on a replacement 30DDTX engine?
faqs.a: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

faqs.q: Do you deliver 3.0 SDV6 engines across the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

faqs.q: How long does a 30DDTX engine replacement usually take?
faqs.a: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed, any body-lift work and additional repairs found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed.

workshopIntro.title: Repair, Rebuild or Replace Your SDV6?
workshopIntro.description: The fault, mileage and value of your Discovery 4 decide the most sensible approach. Turbo, EGR, DPF and oil cooler faults can often be repaired individually. If the bearings have failed or the crankshaft is damaged, a rebuild or Land Rover Discovery 4 30DDTX engine replacement is usually the better long-term option.
paragraphs: Bearing damage is often linked to oil supply or contamination, so we look at the wider system. Where relevant, we inspect the oil cooler, turbos, intercooler, EGR, DPF and cooling system, and renew the oil, filters and coolant before the engine runs.

Send your registration or VIN with a short description of the symptoms. We will confirm compatibility, explain the options and quote for supply only, supply and fit at our Grays workshop, or delivery across the UK.

engineProblems.title: Common Discovery 4 SDV6 Problems
engineProblems.description: The SDV6 usually gives warnings before major failure, and early investigation can limit repair costs.

cards.title: Big-End Bearing Failure
cards.description: Knocking under load, low oil pressure warnings or metal in the oil may indicate big-end bearing wear, which can lead to crankshaft damage. We test oil pressure and inspect the bearings.

cards.title: Timing and Fuel Pump Belt Ageing
cards.description: The SDV6 uses belts for the camshafts and high-pressure fuel pump. Ageing belts or tensioners can fail and cause severe engine damage. We inspect the belts, tensioners and service history.

cards.title: Primary Turbo and Actuator Faults
cards.description: Lack of power, limp mode or boost fault codes can come from a worn primary turbo, a sticking actuator or leaking boost pipework. We test turbo operation and boost control.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: Coolant and Oil Mixing
cards.description: A milky residue, coolant in the oil or unexplained coolant loss may point to a leaking oil cooler or failed internal seals. We check the fluids and pressure-test the cooling system.

cards.title: EGR and Intake Carbon Build-Up
cards.description: Rough running, hesitation or EGR fault codes may be caused by carbon deposits in the EGR valves, cooler or intake system. We test EGR function and inspect intake condition.

cards.title: Particulate Filter Saturation
cards.description: Repeated regeneration attempts, DPF warnings or reduced power often follow short journeys or underlying faults that prevent the filter clearing. We read soot data and assess the DPF.

engineOverview.title: Land Rover Discovery 4 30DDTX Engine: A Complete 3.0 SDV6 Guide
paragraphs: The Land Rover Discovery 4 30DDTX engine is a later version of the 3.0-litre twin-turbo V6 diesel, used in SDV6 Discovery 4 models. Powerful and refined, it is now high-mileage in many vehicles, and bearing failures, turbo faults, DPF problems and coolant leaks lead owners to seek repair or replacement.

SDV6 engines share a common design with earlier 306DT units, but engine codes, emissions equipment and calibration differ between model years. We identify the correct Land Rover Discovery 4 3.0 SDV6 engine by checking your VIN, engine code and registration.

Whether you need a targeted repair, an engine rebuild or a complete Discovery 4 30DDTX engine replacement, our team assesses the vehicle and explains each option. Call us or send your registration for a written quote.
